title: Mixed Event — My Color! — Episode2 SEKAI's Newest Idol?!

meta.Event Outline: The MORE MORE JUMP! livestream kicks off to a great start! Things are going smoothly, until Shizuku's fear becomes a reality. Shizuku must reevaluate her past and present self in order to arrive at her ultimate decision.

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Miku! Rin!
Hmm. They're not here...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's rare for both of them to be away.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Maybe they're having dinner right now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Isn't it a bit early for that...
Wait, do they even eat dinner...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hello, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wah...! Miku!
You surprised me...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You seem a little different than usual. Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
I have a new friend to introduce to you all today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A new friend?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! We have someone who's going to be performing as an idol with us from now on♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? Who is it...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Time for the big reveal!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It's nice to meet you.
My name is Megurine Luka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: L-Luka...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to putting on some wonderful shows with Miku and Rin from now on.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I hope I can count on your support♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow! What an aura...!
You're dazzling!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're over-exaggerating, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? You already know my name?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Of course. Miku and Rin told me all about you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Like you four discovering your true feelings and forming your own idol group...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And we even talked about a few embarrassing stories that I probably shouldn't repeat in front of everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?! Wait, what are you talking about?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Could it be that... D-Did you see me practicing my autograph last night...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You were practicing your autograph, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm just teasing♪
I was just trying to surprise everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm hoping to get to know more about each of you, so feel free to chat any time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sigh... Don't scare me by saying stuff like that...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You seem like quite the playful type, Ms. Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Well, thank you...
But there's no need to be so formal with me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, then... Just Luka is okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Thank you, Shizuku♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It feels like we're already friends.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka's great at singing, dancing, and talking to the crowd♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah♪ She can really do everything!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I sort of had the impression that Luka's reliable and ladylike, and I guess this means she really is.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah! Her idol aura is so strong too!
Her charisma has to be off the charts!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're right. I'm a little jealous.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? But you're always shining too, Shizuku! You're a great singer and dancer, and I love how you can do anything!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, well... I can't do everything...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It actually takes me longer to memorize songs and dance routines than most.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku may not be the type that can pick up something new immediately, but she makes up for it with her work ethic.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's surprising...
I never would've guessed...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Anyway, shall we get started with our meeting?
We'd love to get your input as well, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! You really started doing livestreams?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yep. We only just did our introduction video, but we're planning on doing more moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, how did it feel, livestreaming?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's really wonderful that we got to see everyone's comments in real-time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Since this was such an important announcement, we thought about recording it beforehand so that we could edit it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I feel like doing it live allowed us to express our feelings better than we could have in a recorded video.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I think so too!
Some of the comments were a bit harsh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But seeing everyone's comments right then and there really made it feel like our feelings reached them! It was really nice!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I get the feeling MORE MORE JUMP! is actually perfectly suited for livestreaming.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. I think our focus should be on livestreaming for the time being.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Focus on... Livestreams...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Our last video was just us doing a short introduction, so I was able to get through it without any issues...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But if we keep doing live videos, I...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Do you have any idea what kinds of streams you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well... There's lots of things I'd like to try, but nothing really concrete. Do you have any ideas, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, well... Um...
I'm sorry. Not off the top of my head.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, that's a tough one. How about you, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not sure. I can't really think of anything specific on the spot either...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But doing something you think the fans will enjoy is probably the best way to go, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Something our fans will enjoy...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh!
I just thought of something!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nice! That was quick!
What have you got, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!... Um... What about showing everyone what we're usually like?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What we're usually like?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! From the fans' perspective, getting the chance to see how their favorite idols act when the cameras are off would feel like a special treat!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They normally only get to see idols on TV or while they're performing, right? I bet seeing everyone in a new light would make them like you even more...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A side of us that we don't show on TV or on stage...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's true. There are a lot of fans out there that like behind-the-scenes stuff.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Won't some of the fans get disillusioned if they learn too much about that side of us?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's definitely a possibility. There are sure to be fans who would prefer not to know what their idols are like in their private lives.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-You think so?
I was always happy to learn...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think it's a really interesting idea! Personally, I think everyone in MORE MORE JUMP! is always super cute♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um... O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If it's worrying you, we can come up with other ideas before making a decision.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The fans are expecting me to be perfect, so that means I can't let my guard down even if it's a behind-the-scenes look.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I can't let my personal circumstances limit what the others can do. Especially not now after finally getting started.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (As long as I can maintain this perfect persona at all times...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm probably overthinking it.
Your idea is wonderful, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Are you really sure it's okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm fine.
I didn't mean to make you worry.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Then let's start planning some content with that idea in mind. Miku, Rin, Luka, thank you for the feedback.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're very welcome!
I'm looking forward to your streams♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm sure the fans will love it too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope so too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to do my best to not disappoint the fans...)
